name: Local Density Bounds via Sliding Window
aliases: Sliding Window Minimum/Maximum for Volume Bounds
Volume density bound computation (sliding window min/max filter)
definition: Computes the minimum and maximum volume density values within a neighborhood defined by search_radius around each voxel. Used to establish local density bounds for volume rendering preprocessing.
summary: Local Density Bounds via Sliding Window computes spatially varying volume density bounds in linear time using monotonic queues, differing from global range calculation and naive filtering.
